svg.title: LinuxONE protects data at rest, in motion and in use
svg.desc: Three states of data on one line. At rest: data while it is stored. In motion: data while it travels across the network. In use: data while it is being processed, on the LinuxONE frame. Each is drawn with a lock. IBM says LinuxONE Emperor 5 protects data at rest, in motion and in use.
